title.description: The idea in a line, in the person's words.

problem.description: What hurts today, and for whom, as the person described it.

proposedOutcome.description: What is true once this is done: the end state, not the solution.

affected.description: The people and the systems it touches, each with how.

who.description: A kind of person, or a system, by name.

constraints.description: What the work must respect: technical, policy, time. Empty when none was named.

decisions.description: Every decision the interview settled, in the order it was settled.

answeredBy.description: `person`, or the name of whoever answered on their behalf.

open.description: What is still undecided, each as a question. Empty only when nothing is.
